description: This file defines the ApiConfig class which contains configuration settings and constants related to API security keys, middleware files, containers, routes, and debug settings for the API module of the project.

classes.name: ApiConfig
classes.description: A class providing static methods and constants for API configuration settings, including security keys, environment flags, and paths to configuration scripts.

methods.name: getDebugExceptions
methods.description: Returns whether debug exceptions are enabled.

methods.name: getSlimSettings
methods.description: Returns the array of Slim framework settings.

methods.name: getContainers
methods.description: Returns the array of container configuration script paths.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Returns the array of route configuration script paths.
